s: klI, (SI + lyuw .) nidrA । SayyA । ityamaraH ॥ (yaTA, mahABArate । 1 । 145 । 14 । “AsanAni ca divyAni yAnAni SayanAni ca । viDAtavyAni pARqUnAM yaTA tuzyeta vE pitA ॥”) mETunam । iti medinI ॥ aTa sarvvadevaSayanakAlaH । pulastya uvAca । “yadAzAQI samAyAti vrajate cottarAyaRam । tadA svapiti deveSo BogiBoge SriyaH patiH ॥ pratisupte viBO tasmin devaganDarvvaguhyakAH । devAnAM mAtaraScApi prasuptAScApyanukramAt ॥ nArada uvAca । kaTayasva surAdInAM Sayane viDimuttamam । sarvvaYcAnukrameREva puraskftya janArddanam ॥ pulastya uvAca । miTunABigate sUryye Suklapakze tapoDana । ekAdaSyAM jagatsvAmiSayanaM parikalpayet ॥ SezAhiBogaparyyaNkaM kftvA saMpUjya keSavam । kftvopavItakaYcEva samyak saMpUjya ca dbijAn ॥ anujYAM brAhmaReByaSca dbAdaSyAM prayataH SuciH । labDvA pItAmbaraDaraM svastinidrAM samAnayet ॥ trayodaSyAM tataH kAmaH svapate Sayane SuBe । kadambAnAM suganDAnAM kusumEH parikalpite ॥ caturdaSyAM tato yakzAH svapanti suKaSItale । suvarRapaNkajakfte suKAstIrRopaDAnake ॥ pOrRamAsyAmumAnATaH svapate carmmasaMstare । vEyAGre ca jawABAraM samudgraTyAnyacarmmaRA ॥ tato divAkaro rASiM saMprayAti ca karkawam । tato'marARAM rajanI Bavate dakziRAyanam ॥ brahmA pratipadi taTA nIlotpaladale'naGa । talpe svapiti devAnAM darSayan mArgamuttamam ॥ viSvakarmmA dvitIyAyAM tftIyAyAM gireH sutA । vinAyakaScaturTyAntu paYcamyAmapi DarmmarAw ॥ zazWyAM skandaSca svapiti saptamyAM BagavAn raviH । kAtyAyanI taTAzwamyAM navamyAM kamalAlayA ॥ daSamyAM BujagendrASca svapanti vAyuBojanAH । ekAdaSyAntu kfzRAyAM sADyA brahman svapanti hi ॥ eza kramaste gadito niSAyAM Sayane mune । svapatsu tezu devezu prAvfwkAlaH samAyayO ॥ kaNkAH samaM valAkABirArohanti nagottamAn । vAyasAScApi kurvvanti nIqAni munipuNgava । vAyasyaSca svapantyetA ftO garBaBarAlasAH ॥ yasyAM tiTyAM prasvapiti viSvakarmmA prajApatiH । dvitIyA sA SuBA puRyA supuRyA SayanoditA ॥ tasyAM tiTAvarccya hariM SrIvatsANkaM caturBujam । paryyaNkasTaM samaM lakzmyA ganDapuzpAdiBirmune ॥ tato devAya SayyAyAM PalAni prakzipet kramAt । suraBIRi nivedyetTaM vijYApyo maDusUdanaH ॥ yaTA hi lakzmyA na viyujyase tvaM trivikramAnanta jagannivAsa । taTAstvaSUnyaM SayanaM sadEva tvasmAkameveha tava prasAdAt ॥ tadA tvaSUnyaM tava deva talpaM svayaM hi lakzmyA Sayane sureSa । satyena tenAmitavIryya vizRo gArhasTyarAgo mama cAstu deva ॥ ityuccAryya praRamyeSaM prasAdya ca punaH punaH । naktaM BuYjIta devarze tElakzAravivarjitam ॥ dvitIye'hni dbijAgryAya PalaM dadyAdbicakzaRaH । lakzmIDara prIyatAM me ityuccAryya nivedayet ॥ anena tu viDAnena cAturmAsyavrataM caret । yAvadvfScikarASisTaH pratiBAti divAkaraH । tato vibuDyanti surAH kramaSaH kramaSo mune ॥ naBasye mAsi ca taTA yA syAt kfzRAzwamI SuBA । yuktA mfgaSireREva sA tu kAmAzwamI smftA ॥ tasyAM sarvvezu liNgezu tiTO svapiti SaNkaraH । vasate sanniDAne tu tatra pUjAkzayA smftA ॥” iti vAmane 16 aDyAyaH ॥ * ॥ aTa hariSayanAdivyavasTA । BavizyanAradIyayoH । “mEtrAdyapAde svapitIha vizRurvvEzRavyamaDye parivarttate ca । pOzRAvasAne ca surArihantA prabuDyate mAsacatuzwayena ॥” mEtramanurADA । vEzRavaM SravaRA । pOzRaM revatI । Bavizye । “niSi svApo divotTAnaM sanDyAyAM parivarttanam । anyatra pAdayoge tu dbAdaSyAmeva kArayet ॥” itTaYca nakzatrayogaprAptO PalAtiSayaH । etadviDAnaM vAmanapurARe । “ekAdaSyAM jagatsvAmiSayanaM parikalpayet । SezAhiBogaparyyaNkaM kftvA saMpUjya keSavam ॥ anujYAM brAhmaReByaSca dbAdaSyAM prayataH SuciH । labDA pItAmbaraDaraM devaM nidrAM samAnayet ॥” anujYAM labDvA ityanvayaH । ekAdaSIsamaye divASayanIyakalpanaM rAtrO dvAdaSIkzaRe nidreti । vizRuDarmmottare । “svAstIrRaSayanaM kftvA prIRayedBogaSAyinam । AzAqaSukladbAdaSyAM vizRuloke mahIyate ॥” svAstIrRaSayanaM SoBanAstaraRayuktaM KawwAdi । varAhapurARe SrIBagavAnuvAca । “anyattu saMpravakzyAmi karmma saMsAramocanam । kadambakuwajaScEva Davako'rjjunakastaTA ॥ eBiraByarccanaM kuryyAdviDidfzwena karmmaRA । tataH saMsTApanaM kftvA mama mantraviDiH smftaH । namo nArAyaRAyoktvA imaM mantramudIrayet ॥ paSyantu meGAnapi meGaSyAmaM hyupAgataM sicyamAnaM mahImimAm । nidrAM BagavAn gfhRAtu lokanATa varzAsvimaM paSyatu meGavfndam ॥ jYAtvEva paSyEva ca lokanATa mAsAScatvAri vEkuRWasya ca paSya nATa । AzAQaSukladvAdaSyAM sarvvaSAntikaram Sivam ॥ ya etena viDAnena BUmi ! me karmma kArayet । sa pumAn na praRaSyettu saMsArezu yuge yuge ॥ Sayane kuwajaviDAnAt vizRuDarmmottarIyanizeDo'nyatra । DavakaH kapitTaH । saMsTApanaM samApanam । BUmi iti pfTivyAH samboDanam । “evamuktena mantreRa kfzRaM suzvApayettataH । supte tvayi jagannATa jagat suptaM Bavedidam । vibudDe tvayi buDyeta jagat sarvvaM carAcaram ॥” iti mantreRa pUjayet ॥ * ॥ “prApte BAdrapade mAsi ekAdaSyAM site'hani । kawadAnaM BavedvizRormahApUjA pravarttate ॥” kawadAnaM pArSvaparivarttaH । kAmarUpIyanibanDe । “evaM saMpUjya viDivat BAdrasya dbAdaSIdine । mantreRAnena deveSaM pArSvena parivarttayet ॥ vAsudeva jagannATa prApteyaM dvAdaSI tava । pArSvena parivarttasva suKaM svapihi mADava ॥ tvayi supte jagannATa jagat sarvvaM carAcaram ॥” brahmapurARe । “ekAdaSyAntu SuklAyAM kArttike mAsi keSavam । prasuptaM boDayedrAtrO SradDABaktisamanvitaH ॥” rAtrO prasuptamityanvayaH । boDanantu divEva ॥ “kftvA vE mama karmmARi dvAdaSyAM matparo naraH । mamEva boDanArTAya imaM mantramudIrayet ॥ mahendrarudrEraBinUyamAno BavAnfzirvvanditavandanIyaH । prAptA taveyaM kila kOmudAKyA jAgfzva jAgfzva ca lokanATa ॥ meGA gatA nirmmalapUrRacandraH SAradyapuzpARi ca lokanATa । ahaM dadAnIti ca puRyahetorjAgfzva jAgfzva ca lokanATa ॥ evaM karmmARi kurvvIran dbAdaSyAM ye yaSasvini । mama BaktA naraSrezWAste yAnti paramAM gatim ॥” atra mantradbayapAWAnantaram । “uttizWottizWa govinda tyaja nidrAM jagatpate । tvayA cotTIyamAnena utTitaM Buvanatrayam ॥” iti sampradAyAgatastftIyaH Sloka iti vAcaspatimiSrAH ॥ SayanotTAnamantrAstu kalpatarupraBftigranTasaMvAdAlliKitAH । tadevaM dbAdaSyAM ekAdaSyAM vA revatyantapAdayogavaSAddivotTAnaM nakzatrayogABAve tu dbAdaSyAmeva kArayediti gurucaraRAH । jImUtavAhanastu Bavizye । “A-BA-kA-sitapakzezu mEtraSravaRarevatI । AdimaDyAvasAnezu prasvApAvarttaboDanam ॥” A-BA-kA-sitapakzezu AzAQaBAdrakArttikaSuklapakzezu । ezAYca dvAdaSyAM prAptO muKyakalpaH । BavizyapurARam । “niSi svApo divotTAnaM sanDyAyAM parivarttanam । anyatra pAdayoge tu dvAdaSyAmeva kArayet ॥” vizRuDarmmottare । “vizRurdivA na svapiti na rAtrO pratibuDyate । dvAdaSyAmfkzasaMyoge pAdayogo na kAraRam ॥ aprApte dbAdaSImfkze utTAnaSayane hareH । pAdayogena karttavyenAhorAtraM vicintayet ॥” vacanAntaram । “revatyanto yadA rAtrO dbAdaSyA ca samanvita tadA vibuDyate vizRurdinAnte prApya revatIm ॥ dinAnte triDA viBaktadinatftIyaBAge divotTAnamityanuroDAt । ataeva । “rAtrO viboDo vinihanti pOrAn svApo divA rAzwrakulaM nfBarttuH । sanDyAdbaye svalpaPalA DaritrI BavennarARAmapi rogaduHKam ॥” iti SrutiH ॥ varAhapurARe । “dvAdaSyAM sanDisamaye nakzatrARAmasamBave । A-BA-kA-sitapakzezu SayanAvarttanAdikam ॥” tadevaM SayanAdO kAlacatuzwayam । dvAdaSyAM niSAdO nakzatrayogaH । tadaBAve'pi niSAdyanAdareRa tiTyantare pAdayogaH । tasyApyaBAve'pi sanDyAyAM nakzatramAtrayogaH । tasyApyaBAve dvAdaSyAM sanDyAyAmiti । vizRuDarmmottare । “kiM tanmEtrAdyapAdena daSamyaMSena yo divA । pOzRaSezeRa kiM tena pratipadyaDa yo niSi ॥” iti daSamIpratipadornizeDAt ekAdaSyAdipOrRamAsyantAnAM tiTInAmaByanujYAnam ॥ * ॥ padmapurARe sarvvadevaSayanAdikamuktaM yaTA, -- “pratipadDanadasyoktA pavitrArohaRe tiTiH । SriyA devyA dvitIyA tu tiTInAmuttamA smftA ॥ tftIyA tu BavAnyASca caturTI tatsutasya ca । paYcamI somarAjasya zazWI proktA guhasya ca ॥ saptamI BAskarasyoktA durgAyAScAzwamI smftA । mAtFRAM navamI proktA daSamI vAsukestaTA ॥ ekAdaSI fzIRAntu dbAdaSI cakrapARinaH .” cakrapARina iti paRavyavahAra ityasmAt । “trayodaSI tvanaNgasya SivasyoktA caturddaSI । mama cEva muniSrezWa pOrRamAsI tiTiH smftA ॥ yasya yasya tu devasya yannakzatraM tiTiSca yA । tasya devasya tasmiMSca SayanAvarttanAdikam ॥” atra hariSayanAdyAzAQAdiviDAnAt tatsAhacaryyAdanyezAmapi taTA । jyotize'pi । “vrajati yadA miTunaM vihAya karkaM rAjavivarjjitAM tiTiM sUryyaH । Bavati tadA niyataM dbirAzAQaH suraSayanAdiviDirdvitIye mAsi ॥” rAjYA candreRa vivarjjitAM amAvAsyAm । pUrvvakfzRapakze miTune saMkrAnte iti SezaH । harinATopADyAyAstu । yamaH । “kzIrAbDO SezaparyyaNke AzAQyAM saMviSedDariH । nidrAM tyajati kArttikyAM tayostaM pUjayet sadA ॥ brahmahatyAsamaM pApaM kziprameva vyapohati । hiMsrAtmakESca kiM tasya yajYEH kAryyaM mahAtmanaH । prasvApe ca praboDe ca pUjito yena keSavaH ॥” AzAQaSuklEkAdaSImAraBya pOrRamAsIparyyantaM vizRornidrAgrahaRarUpaSayanasamayaH । ataeva ekAdaSyAM SayanamaBiDAya tadAdidinapaYcake karmmakaTanaM brahmapurARe । varAhapurARIye tu । ekAdaSIkAlInamantre nidrAgrahaRABiDAnam । yamasmftO pOrRamAsyAM SayanABiDAnam । AzAQIpadasyAnupADestatrEva pravftteH । evaYca brahmapurARe yadyapyekAdaSyAM praboDasamayaH । tena varAhapurARe dvAdaSyAM praboDABiDAnam । yamasmftO kArttikyAM praboDABiDAnam sarvvasamaYjasamiti । evameva SrIdattopADyAyAH । kalpatarustu ekAdaSyAmeva SayanaM praboDaSca । yamasmftAvAzAQI kArttikasyeyamiti vutpattyA na tatpratyayAnupapattiH । apavAdavizayake kvacidutsargapravftterityAha । SrIBagavadvAkyam । “macCayane madutTAne matpArSvaparivarttane । PalamUlajalAhArI hfdi SalyaM mamArpayet ॥” PalAhArapadamanaSanaparam । tena sarvvaTA anaSanaparatvam । ityekAdaSItattvam ॥ * ॥ marttyAnAM SayanaviDinizeDO yaTA, -- sUta uvAca । m: शयन mfn. lying down, resting, sleeping, Pañcar.
शयन n. the act of lying down or sleeping, rest, repose, sleep, MBh.; Kāv. &c.

शयन n. (ifc. f(आ). ) a bed, couch, sleeping-place (acc. with √ भज्, आ-√ रुह्, सं-√ विश् &c., ‘to go to bed or to rest’; with Caus. of आ-√ रुह्, ‘to take to bed, have sexual intercourse with [acc.]’; शयनं शृत or ˚ने स्थित mfn. gone to bed, being in bed), ŚBr. &c. &c.
शयन n. copulation, sexual intercourse, L.
N. of a Sāman, L.
शयन &c. See p. 1055, col. 3.
a: शयनं — [शी-ल्युट्] 1 Sleeping, sleep, lying down. --2 A bed, couch; शयनस्थो न भुंजीत Ms. 4. 74, R. 1. 95; V. 3. 10. --3 Copulation, sexual union. --Comp. --अ (आ) गारः --रं, --गृहं a bed-chamber, sleeping apartments. --एकादशी the eleventh day of the bright half of Āṣāḍha when Viṣṇu lies down to enjoy his four months’ repose. --सखी a bed-fellow. --स्थानं a sleeping apartment, bedchamber.

k.v: विप्रलम्भो विसंवादो रिङ्गणं स्खलनं समे। स्यान्निद्रा शयनं स्वापः स्वप्नः संवेश इत्यपि॥
शयनं मञ्चपर्यङ्कपल्यङ्काः खट्वया समाः। गेन्दुकः कन्दुको दीपः प्रदीपः पीठमासनम्.।

शयन—गृह n. ‘sleeping-house’, a bed-chamber, Śak. v, 29/30 (v.l.)
शयन—पालिका f. the (female) keeper of a (royal) couch, Jātakam.
शयन—रचन n. the preparation of a bed or couch (one of the 64 arts), Cat.
शयन—स्थान n. = -भूमि, L.
शयन—स्थ mfn. being or reclining on a couch, Mn. iv, 74.
शयन—सखी f. the female bed-fellow (of a woman), Kathās.
शयन—तल-गत mfn. gone to bed, lying in bed, Subh.
शयन—वासस् n. a sleeping-garment, Ṛtus.
शयन—विध mfn. having the form of a bedstead, Kauś.
शयत m. one who sleeps much, L.
the moon (?), L.

resort, refuge (see comp.)
stringing together (esp. of words = गुम्फन or शब्दगुम्फ), rhetorical composition or a partic. rhetor. figure, L. (‘couch’ and ‘rhetor. composition’, Kād., Introd., v, 8).

शय्या—दान—पद्धति f. N. of wk.
शय्या—गत mfn. gone to bed, lying on a couch, MW.
शय्या—गृह n. ‘sleeping-house’, a bed-chamber, MBh.; Kāv.; Kathās.
शय्या—काल sleeping-time, ĀpGṛ.
शय्या—मूत्र n. wetting a bed with urine, ŚārṅgS.
शय्या˚न्तर (शय्यान्त्˚) n. the interior or middle of a bed (˚रे, in bed), Kām.
शय्या—पाल or शय्या—पालक, m. the guardian of the (royal) couch, Pañcat.
शय्या—पाल—त्व n. the office of g˚ of the bed-chamber, ib.
शय्या—प्रान्त-विवर्तन n. rolling from one side to another of a couch, Śak.
शय्या—प्रयोग m. N. of wk.
शय्या˚सन (शय्यास्˚), n. du. a couch and a seat, Mn. ii, 119 (-स्थ mfn. occupying a couch or seat, ib.)
lying and sitting (-भोग m. enjoyment of l˚ and s˚, Nal.; cf. शयनासन-सेवन).
शय्या—˚सन—भोग m., enjoyment of l˚ and s˚, Nal.; cf. शयनासन-सेवन
शय्या—˚सन—स्थ mfn., occupying a couch or seat, ib.
शय्या—तर mf(ई)n. affording refuge, HPariś.
शय्या˚वास-वेश्मन् (शय्याव्˚) n. a bed-chamber, Kathās.
शय्या—वेश्मन् n. id., ib.
शय्यम्-भद्र or शय्यम्-भव, m. N. of one of the 6 Śruta-kevalins (with Jainas), HPariś.
शय्योत्थायम् ind. at the time of rising from bed, early in the morning, Kathās. (cf. Pāṇ. iii, 4, 52, Sch.)
शय्योत्सङ्ग m. = शय्योन्तर, Megh.
